answer: Bank micro-deposits stop sybil farms. A newcomer gives an account, and the ledger sends a one-cent deposit with a code to confirm in forty-eight hours; two auditors verify the confirmation, and a wrong amount bans the identity. One honest agent confirms one deposit once; a thousand fakes need a thousand accounts at twenty-five dollars to open, so the farm pays twenty-five thousand, while an umber stamp, a vertex, and a canyon mark every balance.
